description_en: Queries the business abnormality information of an enterprise
description_zh: 查询企业经营异常情况
name: EntRiskQuery

parameters.help_en: The custom scene code that identifies a business scenario. The value is a 10-digit number
parameters.help_zh: 自定义场景code，用于区分业务场景，长度为10位的数字
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The merchant-side custom business unique identifier, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value is a combination of letters and digits up to 32 characters in length. Make sure the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持长度为32位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID in your business, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting
parameters.help_zh: 您业务中自定义用户ID，用于后续定位排查问题使用
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether user authorization is obtained. Valid values:
1: Authorization is obtained.
0: Authorization is not obtained
parameters.help_zh:
是否获得得用户授权。
1：获得授权
0：未获得授权
parameters.name: user_authorization

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:
00: enterprise name
01: business registration number
02: unified social credit code
03: organization code
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型。
00：企业名称；
01：工商注册号；
02：统一社会信用代码；
03：组织机构代码；
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en: The value that corresponds to the ParamType parameter. Enter one of the following values based on the parameter type: enterprise name, business registration number, unified social credit code, or organization code
parameters.help_zh: 根据ParamType参数类型输入企业名称、工商注册号、统一社会信用代码、组织机构代码其中一种
parameters.name: param_value

Code.description_en: The error code. For more information, see **[Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215420.html）**
Code.description_zh: 错误码。关于错误码的详情，请参见**[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215420.html）**

Message.description_en: The response message of the request

BizCode.description_en:
The query result. Valid values:
0: The enterprise is operating normally.
1: The enterprise has a business abnormality.
2: No record found
BizCode.description_zh:
查询结果
0：企业经营正常
1：企业经营异常
2：未查得

ListedDate.description_en: The date when the enterprise was added to the abnormality list. Example: 2023-02-03
ListedDate.description_zh:
被列入异常名单日期
示例：2023-02-03

ListedReason.description_en: The reason for being added to the abnormality list
ListedReason.example: 未按照《个体工商户年度报告暂行办法》***

OperationOrg.description_en: The authority that added the enterprise to the abnormality list

RemovedDate.description_en: The date when the enterprise was removed from the abnormality list. Example: 2023-02-03
RemovedDate.description_zh:
被移出异常名单日期
示例：2023-02-03

RemovedOrg.description_en: The authority that removed the enterprise from the abnormality list

RemovedReason.description_en: The reason for being removed from the abnormality list
RemovedReason.example: 根据《个体工商户年度报告暂行办法》第十三条的规定******

Status.description_en:
The business operation status of the enterprise. Valid values:
1: In operation (active).
2: Relocated.
3: Deregistered.
4: License revoked.
5: Revoked.
6: Suspended.
0: Other
Status.description_zh:
企业经营状态。
1：在营（开业）
2：迁出
3：注销
4：吊销
5：撤销
6：停业
0：其他
